measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to first documented disease progression per iwCLL 2018 criteria or death from any cause, whichever occurs first; Participants; Independent review committee (IRC) assessment using iwCLL 2018 criteria; Kaplan-Meier method for PFS and 24-month landmark estimates; stratified log-rank test and stratified Cox proportional hazards model using randomization strata.; Progression-free survival defined as time from random assignment to documented disease progression per iwCLL 2018 criteria or death from any cause, whichever occurs first. The 24-month landmark is a Kaplan-Meier PFS estimate at 24 months. Hazard ratio is pirtobrutinib versus BendaR.

Time to event: randomization to death from any cause; Participants; Kaplan-Meier method; stratified log-rank test and stratified Cox proportional hazards model using randomization strata. OS includes the crossover period for BendaR patients who crossed over to pirtobrutinib.; Overall survival defined as time from random assignment to death from any cause. Median follow-up estimated by reverse Kaplan-Meier. Hazard ratio is pirtobrutinib versus BendaR.

Occurrence: best overall response of complete response (CR), CR with incomplete bone marrow recovery (CRi), nodular partial response (nPR), or partial response (PR) at or before initiation of subsequent anticancer therapy; Participants; IRC assessment using iwCLL 2018 criteria; 95% CI and stratified Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test.; ORR defined as the proportion of patients with best overall response of CR, CRi, nPR, or PR at or before initiation of subsequent anticancer therapy; denominator is the total number randomized per arm. Response assessed by IRC.

population.intervention_regimen: Pirtobrutinib 200 mg orally once daily; bendamustine 90 mg/m2 intravenously on days 1 and 2 of each 28-day cycle; rituximab 375 mg/m2 intravenously on day 1 of cycle 1, then 500 mg/m2 on day 1 of cycles 2-6.; Pirtobrutinib given continuously in 28-day cycles until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; BendaR given as fixed-duration six 28-day cycles. BendaR recipients could cross over to pirtobrutinib after IRC-confirmed progressive disease.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment assignment; combined group of both treatment arms for the ITT population.; Adults aged 18 years or older with treatment-naive CLL/SLL requiring therapy per iwCLL 2018 criteria, without evidence of del(17p), and ECOG performance status 0-2; all patients randomly assigned 1:1 to pirtobrutinib or BendaR. Crossover from BendaR to pirtobrutinib was permitted after IRC-confirmed progressive disease.
population.population_time_frame: Randomized from December 6, 2021 to April 13, 2023; data cutoff July 11, 2025.
